input.source: M119 paper position mark-to-market time-series JSON

intent_rules.eligible: latest position exit_signal is in the configured exit signal list and has suggested_close_action plus suggested_close_quantity
intent_rules.intent_id: stable hash of source_router_run_id, symbol, close action, close quantity, and exit_signal

safety.description: M120 records paper exit intents only. It does not close paper positions, call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
